answer: Since the beacon audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, as the declared depth is logged in the mesa receipt and checked against the oasis nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 158 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
